description: This file defines the interface 'RegistrationClient' for accessing Hono's Registration API, including methods for asserting device registration status with optional gateway and tracing context parameters.

classes.name: RegistrationClient
classes.description: An interface for interacting with Hono's device registration API, scoped to a specific tenant, providing methods to check registration status.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Asserts that a device is registered and enabled, with an overload supporting optional gateway authorization and tracing context.

calls: assertRegistration(String deviceId, String gatewayId, SpanContext context)
